title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta27

## Semantic cutting vs travel preparation

This prerelease prepares the backend for the next Map Card live-route cleanup.
The goal is to stop presenting every active-session movement as a mowing-width
trail while keeping Map Card 0.3.7-beta15 fully compatible.

The change is general and applies to all mower families, not only X3.

### Stricter cutting-edge classifier

The shared completed/current-cycle session renderer now treats an edge as mowed
only when:

- both endpoint samples are confirmed blade-on;
- both endpoint samples have a physical mowing-zone id;
- both endpoint samples belong to the same physical zone.

Zone-boundary crossings, samples outside/without a mowing zone, pause/return
movement and other transit remain travel.

The previous rule required both endpoints to be blade-on but accepted an edge
when only one endpoint had a zone id. That could widen the mowed footprint
across a zone boundary.

The public completed-session render schema stays at version 2. A separate
`classifier_version: 2` is now part of the render fingerprint, so retained
History render caches built with the older classifier are rebuilt once during
prewarm without introducing an API schema break.

## Separate semantic Prepared Live resource

The existing Prepared Live resource remains the same all-movement route used by
Map Card beta15.

Beta27 additionally prepares a separate content-addressed
`live_semantic_route` resource. It is advertised by the existing prepared
render manifest and contains:

- SVG-ready `cutting_segments`;
- SVG-ready `travel_segments`;
- active History session identity;
- source point count;
- cutting/travel segment and render-point counts;
- classifier metadata.

The semantic resource is generated at the same coalesced 30-second cadence as
the existing live backbone, with immediate lifecycle rebuilds.

It is **not downloaded by Map Card beta15**. The existing live resource body has
the nested semantic model removed before encoding, so beta15 does not pay for
the additional route geometry over Nabu Casa.

A future card can fetch the advertised descriptor through:

`?live_semantic_route_render=<resource_id>`

The resource uses the same authenticated content-addressed ETag/conditional
response path as the existing prepared static/live resources.

## Separate semantic short tail

The beta25 contracts remain unchanged:

- `prepared_live_tail=1`;
- `prepared_live_tail_only=1`.

Beta27 adds an independent semantic contract:

- `prepared_live_semantic_tail=1`;
- `prepared_live_semantic_tail_only=1`.

The semantic tail is derived from the exact active timestamped History session
and contains only post-backbone cutting/travel fragments, with one overlap point
for continuity.

When `prepared_live_semantic_tail_only=1` is used and the semantic tail is
safely aligned, full raw `trail` / `trail_segments` are omitted. If the
semantic base is unavailable, the session changes, the route rewinds or the
128-point safety cap is exceeded, raw trail remains available as fallback.

Semantic-tail work is not performed for normal beta15 requests.

## Diagnostics

Prepared Render Model diagnostics now additionally expose:

- semantic live resource ready/id/byte size;
- semantic publication revision;
- semantic resource reads, served bytes and 304 count;
- semantic resource first/last read ages;
- whether the current semantic model is available;
- semantic active-session source point count;
- cutting/travel segment and render-point counts;
- semantic-tail request/success/fallback counters;
- latest semantic-tail point, cutting-segment, travel-segment and fallback
  reason.

Prepared History diagnostics add:

- `render_classifier_version: 2`.

After beta27 installation, existing retained History resources may show
one-time prewarm rebuild activity as old classifier-v1 fingerprints are replaced.

## Compatibility

Map Card 0.3.7-beta15 remains supported unchanged.

The existing all-movement Prepared Live resource and beta25 short-tail contract
remain available with their previous response shape. The new semantic resource
and semantic tail are opt-in only.

Prepared History manifest/resource URLs and schema remain unchanged.

## Frontend work intentionally deferred

This backend beta prepares the data needed for the next Map Card change. It does
not change presentation.

The following are frontend tasks for the next card beta:

- render semantic cutting and travel independently;
- hide or render transit as a thin/subtle line instead of a mowing-width trail;
- apply the same mowed-area opacity to active cutting and existing current-cycle
  swath without double-darkening overlaps;
- immediately hide stale live route geometry when there is no active trail;
- restore selected-session behavior so all sessions for the day remain visible
  while the selected session glows/blinks three times.

Legacy frontend History/raw/daily-trail removal remains a later cleanup after
the new semantic live rendering is field-tested.
